paragraphs.text: Soramaro (SOH-rah-MAH-roh; sora 空 "sky" + maro まろ male suffix) First to Dream , is a kami on Kamigawa that was once a human.

Soramaro has retained some of his human and moonfolk shape, appearing as a robed jushi . His kami aspects are visible in that he has two pairs of arms, floats in the air, and on his lap, his robe pours over a bowl, turning into a stream of water. He also has an extra pair of eyes, and his hair sweeps out in the air behind him, almost like wings. Stone lanterns float in the air around him.

Soramaro was a half- human , half- soratami wizard on Kamigawa . He studied the ways of magic and was so revered by his students that his spirit became a kami . His descendants were still active during the Kami War .
